title: Mixed Event — Take the Best Shot! — Episode8 After The Battle

meta.Event Outline: For Valentine's Day, Kohane hopes to buy An the chocolates she wants to try, but unfortunately, they're all sold out. Then, she learns that those chocolates are one of the prizes for a Valentine's Day photo contest being held by a makeup brand!

rows.Line: A few hours later
Diner

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
(Entries are closed.
That means...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
...!
We have an update!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Does that mean...?!
Yeah, the results are in!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Alright, who made it in...?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
We made it...!
Our account name is on the list!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Really...?!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: We did it, Kohane!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Wow...!
Thank you both so much!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh, but...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Congratulations, Azusawa...
You too, Toya, Kiritani.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
We came in twelfth.
We were so close.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Yes, that is unfortunate...
Especially considering how hard you tried, Ena...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
But I can't complain about the results...
I mean, you guys did take a really amazing picture.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: That being said, this is still beyond frustrating.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Ena...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Um, Ena...?
Would you like to have the makeup that's included in the prize?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: What?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I don't think we would've been able to take the photo we did if you weren't here competing against us.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: So, I'd like you to have it...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Azusawa...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Wait, are you sure...?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yes. We were actually only after the chocolates, so I feel the makeup should go to you since you'd actually use it.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I'm not sure how to feel about being rewarded despite not placing in the top ten...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: But I'll probably feel worse if I rejected your offer, Azusawa.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hehe. I agree.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Thank you. I promise to make great use of them...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: You're welcome...!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Still, this ended up being a pretty action-packed day. It's funny how this all started with us hanging out at a cafe together...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I know, right? Who would've guessed that we'd end up competing against Toya and his team like this.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
I definitely wouldn't have...
But I had a lot of fun trying something new.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (Speaking of which...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Um... There's actually something I'd like to show all of you.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Oh, what do you wanna show us?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: This photo...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: This looks like... Just now when we started talking after we'd finished shooting...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
You took one of us?
This is so wonderful. Look at the way we're all smiling.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yes, I saw that and decided to take a photo.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Azusawa, if possible, can you send me a copy of this...?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: It ended up being kind of a long day, but seeing this picture reminded me of just how much fun I had competing against you guys...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Ena...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
I had fun as well.
I enjoyed taking pictures with Kohane and Aoyagi, and our little rivalry.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: So, Kohane, mind also sending me a copy...?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Me as well.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Okay...!
I'll send it over once I've had a chance to retouch it a little!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (It's so great how photos allow you to relive happy moments like these and share them with others...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (This is why I love photography so much...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Oh, since we're all gathered like this, why don't we take a group photo to mark the occasion? You weren't in that other one, Azusawa.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Yeah!
Then, let's squeeze in a bit so that Ena can get us all.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Kohane, come closer.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: O-Okay!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Ready? Three, two, one...
bgm_area00005
Valentine's Day
Empty SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Oh, Ena, Happy Valentine's Day!
Did you bring the goods...?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Of course, I did.
That's why I asked you all to gather here. So, here they are.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Whoa, this wrapping's super cute!
Hang on. This looks pretty pricey!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Because it is. I wasn't sure about it at first, but I decided to get it after you said that you'd be getting a big bag of chocolates for us all to share. A case of quality over quantity...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Thanks, Ena!
Now I really can't wait for our party to get started♪

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: By the way...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
You seem kinda different today...
Oh, is it your makeup? Did you try something new...?!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Hehe. You noticed?
I'm using a new kind of eye shadow today.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
I knew it!
It looks really cute on you! What brand?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
It's by Colore Mi.
Actually, it's the one they made in collaboration with Couleur Chocolat.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
What?!
I thought they ran out immediately after they started taking orders.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: They did, but one thing led to another and I managed to get my hands on it. From Azusawa.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Huh? Azusawa...? You mean Kohane? What does she have to do with this?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Hehe. The thing is...
bgm_area00002
Stage SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
What?!
You all entered into a photo contest together?!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah, and we ended up battling against Haruka for the prize.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
I still can't believe that happened.
Airi and Shizuku were taking pictures of Ena, and she was so good at making all these different expressions.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Really...?!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
No fair.
I wanna see the pictures you guys took.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Then, I'll ask to see if it's okay for me to show you. I'm sure they'll say yes anyway.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
But we all had so much fun.
We even ended up having dinner together afterwards.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yeah, and it was great to be able to use everything I learned about being an idol to help Kohane as her friend...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Haruka...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
I know exactly what you mean.
It filled me with so much joy when Ena said how happy she was about the pictures we took.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hehe. Sounds like you all had a wonderful day...♪

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: We did.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Oh, I made sure to bring the chocolates we won. Why don't we have some before we start practicing?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Including us?
Thanks, Haruka.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: These look lovely♪
Street SEKAI
Crase Cafe

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: *Sob*

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: They look so pretty... And delicious...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: But...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah, this company really knows how to make good chocolates.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Definitely! I don't think I've ever had any as good as these before!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: And they go incredibly well with coffee.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
*Sob*
Don't tempt me by shoving how much you're enjoying them in my face...!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Just have some already, will you?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: But... If I eat them, they'll be gone forever...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Um, An...?
It'd make me really happy if you do eat them...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
*Nod*
I definitely will! I promise...!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: But I wanna cherish them just a little while longer...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: It's also not about just how cute these chocolates are... You worked really hard to get these for me. I don't even know how to begin thanking you!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: An...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: You really are the best, Kohane!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hehe... You're welcome!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: But I was only able to get these because of the help I received. I really appreciate what you did, Aoyagi.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I couldn't believe it when you said that you entered into that photo contest, but credit where credit's due. Thanks for these...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: You're welcome.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (I'm so glad that An and Shinonome like their gifts...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (I couldn't have done this without Aoyagi and Haruka, but I'm really glad I decided to take a chance at that photo contest...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (Also...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (I want to keep taking photos of precious moments like these and leave behind a nice record.)

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Oh, Kohane, can you show us the pictures of Toya you took?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Yeah, I wanna see too!
And you gotta tell us more about this contest!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Okay!
I took some photos of him while he was getting ready, so I'll explain while showing you those.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Let's start with... This one.
